source: National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1997 (BLS), public release rounds 1-21 (1997-2023/24); respondents born 1980-84, first marriages begun 1995-2024 followed prospectively from the wedding month
target: Annual rate of separation or divorce of a FIRST marriage per marriage-year from the wedding month (monthly marital-status array: first month separated or divorced); widowhood and last interview censor (Poisson rate, not a probability)
population: U.S. residents born 1980-84 (aged 12-16 at the end of 1996) in their FIRST marriage, either sex, opposite-sex spouses of any marital history; respondent report plus the household roster for the spouse
weights: Round-1 sampling weight (cumulative cases), normalised to mean 1 over first marriages, times exposure. The NLS custom-weight program (multi-round panel weights) is web-only; round-1 weights do not adjust for later attrition

inputs.marriage_years: completed years since the wedding at the start of the year being scored (0 = first year)
inputs.sex: Male/Female: the person whose traits are entered as "own" (the NLSY97 respondent)
inputs.race_ethnicity: Black, Hispanic, Non-Black non-Hispanic (NLSY97 KEY!RACE_ETHNICITY; mixed race grouped with non-Black non-Hispanic)
inputs.age_at_marriage: own age in years on the wedding day
inputs.region: Census region at the last interview before the wedding: Northeast, North Central, South, West, Unknown
inputs.urban: Urban/Rural/Unknown at the last interview before the wedding
inputs.cohabited_first: Yes/No: lived with this spouse in the month before the wedding
inputs.cohab_months_before: months lived together before the wedding (0 if not); clipped at 120
inputs.prior_cohabitations_band: 0, 1, 2+: earlier live-in partners other than this spouse
inputs.children_before_marriage: 0, 1, 2+: own biological children born before the wedding month
inputs.pregnant_at_wedding: Yes/No: a biological child born in the wedding month or the 7 months after
inputs.parent_max_grade: highest grade completed by either biological parent (1997 report; resident parents if missing)
inputs.family_at_12: Both biological parents / Biological parent and step or other parent / Single biological parent / Other arrangement / Unknown: who the respondent lived with at age 12 (a proxy for parental separation, not a direct measure)
inputs.poverty_ratio_1997: household income / poverty line in 1996 (parent household); clipped at 10
inputs.religion_raised: Catholic, Protestant, None, Other, Unknown (own religious preference in 1997, ages 12-16)
inputs.parent_attendance_1997: parent's worship attendance in 1997: Never, Less than monthly, About monthly, Weekly or more, Unknown
inputs.afqt_percentile: ASVAB math-verbal percentile (0-100; tested 1997-98, before almost every wedding)
inputs.first_sex: Under 15, 15-16, 17 or older or not by 2001, Unknown (2000-01 reports)
inputs.attendance_before: own worship attendance at the last interview before the wedding: Never, Less than monthly, About monthly, Weekly or more, or "Not measured before wedding" (asked from 2000; weddings before then)
inputs.mhi5_before: 5-item mental health inventory, 0-100 (higher = better), last interview before the wedding (2000-2010, 2015 rounds)
inputs.education_at_marriage: No high school credential, High school or GED, Associate, Bachelor, Graduate degree (credential dated before the wedding month)
inputs.enrolled_at_marriage: Yes/No: enrolled in college in the wedding month
inputs.hours_year_before: hours worked in the calendar year before the wedding year (0-4000)
inputs.earnings_year_before_k: own wage and salary income in the calendar year before the wedding year, $1000s nominal (0-150)
inputs.net_worth_before_k: household net worth at the age-20 or age-25 assets interview if it preceded the wedding, $1000s (-50 to 250); null if not measured
inputs.spouse_age_gap: spouse's age minus own age at the wedding, years (-15 to 25)
inputs.spouse_education: Less than 12 years, 12 years, 13-15 years, 16+ years (spouse's highest grade completed)
inputs.same_race_ethnicity: Same/Different: derived from race_ethnicity and spouse_race_ethnicity
inputs.spouse_married_before: Yes/No; Unknown when the partner was first listed before 2011 (not asked)
inputs.spouse_has_children: Yes/No: spouse had children with someone else; Unknown when first listed before 2011
inputs.pair_sex_age: derived: sex + " x " + age band of age_at_marriage (under 22, 22-25, 26-29, 30+); spline_pairs model only
inputs.pair_education: derived: own education coarse + " x spouse " + spouse education coarse, each HS or less / Some college / BA+ (Associate and 13-15 years are Some college); spline_pairs model only
inputs.pair_cohab_age: derived: cohabited_first + " x " + age band; spline_pairs model only

abstain: same-sex couples (62 identified same-sex first marriages were excluded)
either partner previously married on the "own" side (first marriages of the respondent only)
own age at marriage outside the support (born 1980-84: weddings at roughly 16-43)
profiles above the ood abstain percentile
timing: Every input is measured at or before the wedding month, from the round before the wedding, from 1997-2001 youth reports, or from dated histories (degrees, births, cohabitation, monthly enrolment). Exceptions: spouse schooling and race-ethnicity come from the household roster at the first interview after the wedding (median about a year later) or, for spouses no longer co-resident then, from the partner section asked about the start of living together; earnings for the year before the wedding can be reported at an interview after it. TIPI personality (2008 only) and CES-D (2019+) were excluded because they postdate most weddings.

weighted_survival.group: family_at_12: Biological parent and step or other parent

population_reference.about: Survey-weighted quantiles of held-out predicted separation or divorce of a first marriage within 5, 10 and 20 years of the wedding, scored with inputs at the wedding by models fitted on the other person folds (first 5-fold split). Lens number = 1 - mean over the scoring models of exp(-cumulative hazard). Each pK is a list aligned to horizons. Subgroup cells have at least 100 unweighted marriages; n is that count. Nothing person-level. The 20-year horizon rests on about 300 marriages still at risk in year 20.

attendance_before.label: Own worship attendance before the wedding

partner_distribution.note: Survey-weighted shares of spouse traits among first marriages with every spouse trait observed, conditional on the respondent (sex, age at marriage band, own education). Rows need at least 30 marriages; a spouse category with fewer than 30 marriages is folded into suppressed_share. Describes who married whom in this cohort; not a recommendation.

models_extended_note: Held-out comparison of richer inputs (2026-10-20, extended_predictors.py). Not scored by the app until the form asks for the new inputs. Blocks whose held-out difference over the current additive model had a 95% CI above zero: none.

inputs_extended.race_detail: race and Hispanic origin (KEY!RACE, KEY!ETHNICITY): Hispanic; non-Hispanic White, Black, American Indian or Alaska Native, Asian or Pacific Islander (one category in NLSY97), Other
inputs_extended.family_origin: who raised the respondent: Both parents (both biological parents at 12) / Parent died (a biological parent deceased by 1997) / Stepfamily (a biological parent and another parent at 12) / Single parent, reason not known (one biological parent at 12; NLSY97 cannot separate divorce, separation and never-married parents) / Other (adoptive, foster, other adults) / Unknown
inputs_extended.attend8: worship attendance in the past 12 months, all eight answers (Never ... Several times a week / Every day), last interview before the wedding; asked from 2000
inputs_extended.prays_often: 'I pray more than once a day' (True/False), last answer before the wedding (asked 2002-2011)
inputs_extended.obey_teachings: 'Religious teachings should be obeyed exactly as written' (True/False)
inputs_extended.asks_god: 'I ask God to help me make decisions' (True/False)
inputs_extended.no_need_religion: 'I don't need religion to have good values' (True/False)
inputs_extended.faith_importance: importance of religious faith in daily life, 5 points (asked 2008 and 2011 only)
inputs_extended.political_interest: follows government and public affairs: most of the time ... hardly at all (2004-2010)
inputs_extended.occupation_group: occupation of the first-listed employer at the last interview before the wedding (2002 Census codes), major group; "No job reported" if none
inputs_extended.financial_assets_k: financial assets ($1,000s, 0-100) at the age-20/25 assets interview, if before the wedding
inputs_extended.debts_k: debts other than mortgage ($1,000s, 0-100) at that interview
inputs_extended.home_owner: owned a home at that interview (Yes / No / Not measured before wedding)
